motivation: The geographic-span analysis showed shorter rainfall-associated span, but max-span compactness conditional on occupied-stop count was not supported. Test whether that result reflects finer spatial structure missed by maximum span.
population: Frozen NAAMP matched pairs restricted to physically stable pairs with complete coordinates for all ten stops.
species_unit: Route-new species absent from the entire dry route and present at >=2 stops in the wet route.
conditional_reference: For each physical route and occupied-stop count k=2..10, enumerate all k-of-10 stop subsets. All spatial scores are compared with this route- and k-specific exact reference, so occupied-stop count and route geometry are held fixed.

metrics.mpd_compactness: 1 - observed mean pairwise geographic distance / exact mean across all random k-stop subsets. Positive means closer together than random k stops.
metrics.mst_compactness: 1 - observed minimum-spanning-tree length / exact mean across all random k-stop subsets. Positive means a shorter connecting network than random k stops.
metrics.adjacency_excess: Observed fraction of occupied StopNumber-neighbor links among the k-1 maximum possible adjacent links, minus its exact random-k expectation. Positive means more route-adjacent clustering.

pair_endpoints: For each metric, sum species-level scores across route-new multi-stop species within a matched pair. Zero if none.
inference: Use the frozen residualized rainfall design and compare each observed rain-contrast coefficient with 1,000 simulations under kappa=2 uniform activation and a=0.75 persistence-preserving activation.

prefixed_rule.convergent_cluster_support: Both total_mpd_compactness and total_mst_compactness must exceed the upper 95% null bound under both nulls. adjacency_excess is secondary corroboration and does not alter the gate.
prefixed_rule.no_cluster_support: Otherwise spatial clustering beyond occupied-stop count is not established.

interpretation: This is explicitly post-readback and diagnostic.
A positive result would support local spatial clustering beyond the number of occupied stops.
A null result means the earlier shorter span is attributable to composition/occupancy-count structure rather than unusual placement of occupied stops conditional on k.
No wetland, movement, atmospheric-cue, or causal rainfall mechanism is identified.
